snippet.title: BIO-SUBMARINER DX - A Game Boy Color Chomp 'Em Up! - Trailer
snippet.description:
Try the demo today! - https://leech.games

BIO-SUBMARINER DX is a horizontally-scrolling Shoot 'Em Up, Chomp 'Em Up developed for Game Boy Color!
Set sail, devour your enemies from surface to sea floor and destroy the enemy CORE!
